name: When Two Roses Collide
source:
Hugh Bolton, first son and heir of Baron Powicke, maintains a secret love affair with his lifelong friend Robert Burdet, son of lord Ross. When the English Civil War we now call the War of the Roses breaks out, they find themselves on different sides of the conflict due to family allegiances. What will become of their love story?  

[From [url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/when-two-roses-collide]itch.io[/url]]
